name: One's First Love
source:
Main character is a salary-man who lives alone. One day he goes for work later than usual and bumps into a high school girl who vomits on him. Such unique encounters happen to him occasionally. Maybe such encounter is the way to his first love? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一个独居的工薪族。有一天，他上班比平时晚了，碰到了一名高中女生，她吐在了他身上。这种独特的遭遇偶尔会发生在他身上。也许这样的邂逅就是他的初恋之路？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
